app.name: Vibe Build
mode.line: Scripted mode: no AI model is connected. The real-model gate is closed.
simulated.note: Fixed content written in advance by Claude Code (the AI assistant building this project); no model call by the builder.
sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.footnote: Single-user sign-in for a prototype. Not single sign-on, not hardened.
sign_in.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Sign-in is locked for {seconds} seconds.
setup.title: Choose your password
setup.intro: This interface has no password yet. The first person to reach this page sets it. Use 12 characters or more.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.too_short: The password must be 12 characters or more.
setup.already: The password is already set. Sign in.
setup.done: Password set. Sign in with it.
projects.title: Projects
projects.others: Projects made outside this interface are not shown: {n}.
col.name: Name
new.title: New project
new.name: Project name
new.cap_help: The most this project may spend on model calls. Scripted steps spend $0, but each step must fit its reservation.
new.made_up: Made-up data only. No customer or personal details.
brief.title: Your brief
brief.simulated_analyst: Simulated analyst: fixed questions for test example 1 (leave requests). It does not read your brief; every brief continues as example 1. A real analyst needs the model key (milestone 2).
brief.stopped: This project is stopped. Nothing more happens to it.
questions.title: Questions
questions.something_else_help: Type it here. It is logged as a sign that an option is missing.
questions.their_call: Their call: only you can answer this, so nothing is recommended.
questions.recorded_verbatim: Recorded word for word; nothing is recommended.
questions.fields_note: The fields are the app spec's, in English.
questions.scripted_customer: Answer the rest from example 1's answer sheet (scripted customer)
questions.differs: Recorded. The scripted build always builds example 1's answers.
questions.by_sheet: Answered by the scripted customer, from example 1's answer sheet.
questions.not_yet: The questions start once you continue with example 1.
proposal.title: Proposed app
proposal.in_english: The app spec of example 1 is written in English; its content is shown as written.
proposal.confirm_sentence: Confirm this brief, or tell me what to change. Nothing is built until you confirm.
proposal.no_change: Changing the brief is not available in scripted mode: the build is always example 1.
proposal.not_yet: The proposed app is shown once every question is answered.
plan.title: Build steps
plan.not_built: Not built in scripted mode: team queue, HR table, approve, reject, withdraw, balance. Checklist items 2 to 6 cannot pass.
plan.quality_gate: Quality gate after each step: not done (milestone 1).
plan.tests_fixed: Confirming the plan fixes the checklist's tests. They are stand-in tests, not independent acceptance.
plan.confirmed: Plan confirmed. Tests fixed as version {version}: stand-in test, not independent acceptance.
plan.not_yet: The build steps are shown once the brief is confirmed.
plan.build_not_here: The build screen is not in this version of the interface yet.
record.title: Record
record.order: Every event of this project, in the order it was written (event number), not by clock time.
cost.title: Cost
cost.read_only: Read-only. Changing the cap is a recorded change Claude Code makes when you ask.
cost.held: Held for calls in progress or awaiting reconciliation
cost.zero: Spent: $0.00. No model was called. This is not the cost of a real build.
cost.no_steps: No step has been reserved yet.
cost.priced: Step reservations are sized at {model}'s prices, from the price table of {date}.
interrupted.message: A job of this project was interrupted when the interface stopped. It is not resumed. Close the project, or start a new one.
error.title: Not done
error.english_only: The reason is given in English.
error.server: Something went wrong. The project's record shows what was written.
